mostWorthwhile.text: Catching bacteria with a white blood cell was most worthwhile: the two panels showed the bacterium being enclosed and broken apart.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished defenses to the body felt least worthwhile because it mostly repeated their locations, though it completed the model.

surprise.text: The final result clarified that these defenses catch many particles and microbes, but not everything we breathe in.

arbitrary.text: Combining the two defenses before connecting them to the body felt a little like an assembly requirement; the cutaway explained their different locations, though.

continue.text: I might continue: the two defenses were easy to follow, and comparing what happens in different parts of the lungs was interesting. The final assembly was less engaging.
